title: Meridian Base mechanics repair

backup.restore: Stop Minecraft; verify with backup_world.py --verify; move damaged save aside; extract the archived world folder under .minecraft/saves, preserving archive.

geometry.scope: Seven existing y=-30 outer ring droppers become upward dispensers. No new holes, floors, walls or route changes. Original machine droppers stay intact.

ocean_policy: Only actual exterior ocean block contact at y<=-33 eliminates live participants. Indoor water/bubble columns stay safe. Scene escape returns to validated spawn; exact original arena predicate retained for editor and spawn membership.
elevator: Existing cyan shaft lower blackstone buttons teleport their actual presser up to an indoor landing; upper blackstone controls teleport back. Labels show SECOND FLOOR / GROUND FLOOR.
food: One always-edible potato appears at a random plantation marker every 10–25 seconds, at most three dropped. Eating grants Speed I and Jump Boost I for exactly 200 ticks.
dispenser: Each player fresh entry onto a pad rerolls 50/50 between a dropped swiftness potion and an upward firework exploding after 18 ticks. Items are generated on demand; empty locked inventory never depletes. Leaving the pad resets entry state.

validation.static: tests/test_meridian_mechanics.py reads actual save state, landings, buttons, boundary and component data.
